game_title: Flowchart Lab · Count up to n
game_concept: A racing platformer set in Mt. Pyre – Lava Tube Tunnel, a glowing lava tube: the volcanologist must handle lava imps while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – String Glue: Concatenate string pieces to forge passwords and spell names.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Lava Tube Tunnel: a glowing lava tube
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Read n. Print the whole numbers from 1 through n. If n is zero, print nothing. Test dataset 2: {'n': 0}; {'n': 7}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'String Glue' (Week 2 slot 7), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Lava Tube Tunnel'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the summit beacon by solving code steps involving spell_ok that move the volcanologist forward.
source_win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.05).
source_lose_condition: The rival reaches the summit beacon first, or lives reach 0.
source_game_title: String Glue – Lava Tube Tunnel Race
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
